practical_problems.note: the benchmark withholds each target-period release and scores faithfulness to cutoff-valid evidence over 24 periods; it measures how current agents fail (temporal misuse, memory decay), and does not ablate a cutoff-enforcement mechanism

summary: A live, cutoff-isolated benchmark for recurring time series analysis that measures answer accuracy and cutoff-faithful reporting across six LLMs, plus a skill-library agent whose gains are shown only as a small in-benchmark ablation; forecasting appears as one of six question families, where agents score lowest.
